```{r load library, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(magrittr)
library(ggeffects)
```

```{r load data}
raw <- bind_rows(read.csv("../data/formal-pilot/data-task-pkec.csv"), read.csv("../data/formal-pilot/data-task-pkec2.csv"), read.csv("../data/formal-pilot/frankie-data-task-pkec.csv"), read.csv("../data/formal-pilot/qiyan-data-task-pkec.csv"), read.csv("../data/formal-pilot/jacob-data-task-pkec.csv")) %>%
  rename(ID = 'Participant.Private.ID',
         list = 'counterbalance.gj4p',
         word = 'Spreadsheet..word',
         stim = 'Spreadsheet..stim',
         trial_type = 'Spreadsheet..trial_type',
         blockID = 'Spreadsheet..blockID',
         rt = 'Reaction.Time', 
         condition = 'Spreadsheet..condition',
         VOT = 'Spreadsheet..VOT')%>%
  filter(Display == "phonetic categorization") %>%
  filter(Screen == "2AFC") %>%
  filter(Response.Type == "response") %>%
  #filter(Response != "") %>%                    # drop screen-advance events (blank Response)
  #mutate(
  #  catch = case_when(
  #    str_detect(stim, "left")  ~ Spreadsheet..left,
  #    str_detect(stim, "right") ~ Spreadsheet..right,
  #  ))%>%
  #mutate(catch.corr = if_else(catch == Response, 1, 0))%>%
  #mutate(VOT = as.numeric(str_extract(stim, "(?<=_)[^.]+"))) %>%
  mutate(resp.num = case_when(
      str_detect(Response, "^t") ~ 1,
      str_detect(Response, "^d") ~ 0))
  #mutate(word = str_extract(stim, "^[^_]+" ))
```

```{r}

#check counterbalanced list assignment
sum.list.assign <- raw %>%
  group_by(list) %>%
  summarise(n_subjects = n_distinct(ID))

#check catch trial accuracy
sum.catch_accuracy <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type == "catch") %>% 
  mutate(catch.corr = if_else(word == Response, 1, 0)) %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_catch = n(),
    accuracy = mean(catch.corr)
  )

#check trial number in each exposure and test blocks
sum.trial.num <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch") %>% 
  group_by(ID, blockID) %>% 
  summarise(
    trial_num = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = blockID, 
    values_from = trial_num
  )


```

```{r}

participant.condition <- raw %>%
  filter(condition != "") %>%
  distinct(ID, condition)

data.plot <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch") %>%
  left_join(participant.condition, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(blockID = factor(blockID, levels = c("T1","A","T2","B","T3","C","T4","T5","T6")), ID = factor(ID)) %>%
  group_by(ID, blockID) %>%
  summarise(mean.prop = mean(resp.num), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(data.plot, aes(blockID, mean.prop, colour = ID, group = ID)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Block", y = "Proportion /t/")

```

```{r}

#prepare dataset for crticial trials
df.critical.trial <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch", !is.na(resp.num)) %>%
  left_join(participant.condition, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(ID = as.factor(ID)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  mutate(
    block_order = match(blockID, unique(blockID)),
    
    exp_stageID = c("Test 1", "Exposure 1", 
                         "Test 2", "Exposure 2", 
                         "Test 3", "Exposure 3", 
                         "Test 4", "Test 5", "Test 6")[block_order],
  ) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  mutate(
    exp_stageID = factor(
      exp_stageID, 
      levels = c("Test 1", "Exposure 1", 
                 "Test 2", "Exposure 2", 
                 "Test 3", "Exposure 3", 
                 "Test 4", "Test 5", "Test 6")
    )
  )
  #filter(blockID %in% c("A", "B", "C"))%>%
  #filter(blockID %in% c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))%>%
```

```{r}

# categorization response as a function of VOT and exposure condition across blocks

#df.by_subj <- raw %>%
#  filter(trial_type != "catch", !is.na(resp.num)) %>%
#  left_join(participant.condition, by = "ID") %>%
#  group_by(ID, blockID, condition.y, VOT) %>%
#  summarise(prop_t = mean(resp.num), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(data=df.critical.trial, aes(x=VOT, y=resp.num, colour = condition.y)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), se = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  facet_wrap(~ exp_stageID) +
  labs(x = "VOT (ms)", y = "Proportion /t/")

```

```{r}

# categorization response by participants

ggplot(data=df.critical.trial, aes(x=VOT, y=resp.num, colour = ID, group = ID)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", 
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.8, height = 0.02), size=1.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ exp_stageID) +
  labs(x = "VOT (ms)", y = "Proportion /t/") +
  theme_bw()

```
